description: Expand the BlogPost data model and seed the 'How to Improve Blood Circulation Naturally' article with all rich content fields. Also add featureImageUrl to existing posts so the blog index card can show thumbnails.
steps: 1. Read src/data/blog.ts in full to understand the current BlogPost interface and blogPosts array.

2. Expand the BlogPost interface in src/data/blog.ts with these new optional fields (all optional to stay backward-compatible with the 4 existing posts):
   - featureImageUrl?: string  (hero image URL)
   - featureImageAlt?: string
   - subtitle?: string  (deck below H1)
   - authorAvatar?: string  (URL to avatar image)
   - authorBrandLine?: string  (e.g. 'Wellness Education Team')
   - updatedDate?: string  (ISO date)
   - categorySlug?: string  (maps to site taxonomy)
   - categoryIcon?: string  (lucide icon name as string, e.g. 'Heart')
   - sections?: ArticleSection[]  (structured body, replaces the flat body string[])
   - bottomLine?: string  (text for the green callout box)
   - recommendedProductSlugs?: string[]  (references to existing catalog products)
   - references?: ArticleReference[]  (structured citations)
   - relatedArticleSlugs?: string[]  (alias for relatedSlugs, but explicit)
   - u20xChallengePath?: string  (per-article U20X destination; falls back to '/u20x' globally)
   - tags?: string[]
3. Add three supporting interfaces to src/data/blog.ts (above BlogPost):
   - ArticleSection: { id: string; heading: string; content: ContentBlock[] }
   - ContentBlock (discriminated union): 
       | { type: 'paragraph'; text: string }
       | { type: 'checklist'; items: { icon?: string; text: string }[] }
       | { type: 'numbered'; items: { number: number; title: string; body: string; imageUrl?: string; imageAlt?: string }[] }
       | { type: 'callout'; text: string; variant?: 'tip' | 'warning' | 'info' }
   - ArticleReference: { id: string; title: string; authors?: string; publisher?: string; year?: number; url?: string }
4. Add a new export to src/data/blog.ts:
   export const GLOBAL_DISCLAIMER = '...full approved disclaimer text...' (the legal text from the brief)
   export const GLOBAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE = '...' (the full copyright paragraph from the brief, with {year} placeholder replaced at render time via new Date().getFullYear())
   export const ARTICLE_CATEGORIES: { slug: string; label: string; icon: string }[] = [...all 9 categories from the brief...]
5. Update the 4 existing posts: add featureImageUrl pointing to existing asset imports (use capsules for all 4 as placeholder, e.g. '/src/assets/product-capsules.jpg' — use the imported asset path). Add categorySlug matching their category string lowercased-slugified. Keep all existing fields untouched.
6. Seed the new circulation article. Add it as the first entry in blogPosts with slug 'improve-blood-circulation-naturally'. Populate ALL new fields:
   - title: 'How to Improve Blood Circulation Naturally'
   - subtitle: 'Simple daily habits that support healthy blood flow from head to toe'
   - category: 'Circulatory Health'
   - categorySlug: 'circulatory-health'
   - categoryIcon: 'Heart'
   - author: 'Ray\'s Healthy Living'
   - authorBrandLine: 'Wellness Education Team'
   - date: '2025-01-15'
   - readTime: '8 min read'
   - featureImageUrl: use the irishMoss asset import placeholder
   - featureImageAlt: 'Illustration of healthy blood circulation'
   - bottomLine: 'Good circulation is built daily — through movement, hydration, whole foods and targeted support. No single habit or supplement does it alone, but together they compound into real, lasting change.'
   - recommendedProductSlugs: ['organic-beet-root', 'full-spectrum-cayenne', 'anthocyanin-bilberry', 'adaptogen-vitality-complex']
   - u20xChallengePath: '/u20x'
   - tags: ['circulation', 'cardiovascular', 'lifestyle', 'nutrition']
   - sections: at minimum 4 ArticleSections derived from the mockup content:
       Section 1 id='why-circulation-matters' heading='Why Circulation Matters'
         — one paragraph ContentBlock explaining blood flow basics
         — one checklist ContentBlock with 5 signs of poor circulation (cold hands/feet, fatigue, numbness, slow wound healing, brain fog)
       Section 2 id='lifestyle-habits' heading='Lifestyle Habits That Support Circulation'
         — one numbered ContentBlock with 4 items: Regular Movement, Stay Hydrated, Quit Smoking, Manage Stress (each with a short body paragraph)
       Section 3 id='foods-for-circulation' heading='Foods That Support Healthy Circulation'
         — one paragraph ContentBlock intro
         — one checklist ContentBlock: Beets, Cayenne Pepper, Berries, Garlic, Fatty Fish, Dark Chocolate, Citrus Fruits
       Section 4 id='targeted-support' heading='Targeted Supplement Support'
         — one paragraph ContentBlock about how supplements work as support, not cures
   - references: 3 structured references (plausible wellness/nutrition sources with year and url placeholders)
   - relatedSlugs: ['understanding-your-wellness-where-to-start', 'building-a-daily-routine-that-sticks']
   - body: [''] (keep empty array to satisfy the existing interface; rendering will use sections)
   - excerpt: 'Small daily habits — movement, hydration, the right foods and targeted support — stack up into meaningfully better circulation over time.'
   - seoTitle: 'How to Improve Blood Circulation Naturally | Ray\'s Healthy Living'
   - metaDescription: 'Learn natural ways to improve blood circulation through movement, diet, hydration and targeted herbal support. Educational content from Ray\'s Healthy Living.'
   - published: true
7. Update getPost() helper to still work (no change needed — it already looks up by slug and published).
8. Also create src/data/article-content.ts as a re-export barrel: `export * from './blog'` so consuming components can import from either path without confusion. This is a single-line file.
acceptance_criteria: bun run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors after these changes
All 4 existing BlogPost entries still satisfy the expanded interface (all new fields are optional)
The circulation article is retrievable via getPost('improve-blood-circulation-naturally') and returns a non-undefined value
GLOBAL_DISCLAIMER, GLOBAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE, and ARTICLE_CATEGORIES are exported from src/data/blog.ts
ArticleSection, ContentBlock, and ArticleReference types are exported from src/data/blog.ts
